text:
Maya Patel: Proposal — split our weekly triage into two lanes: 15m 'quick' (backlog triage, hotfix gating) + 25m 'deep' (one rotating RFC/design topic + a deep bug). Move meeting to Wed 9:30 PT. Thoughts? @here
Ben Ortiz: +1 for the lanes. Makes meetings less noisy. Could we make the quick lane async unless a P0 pops up?
Devon Li: Agree. Suggest owners drop one slide or a short note in the agenda doc beforehand so deep lane isn't surprise-heavy. Also we should reserve a 5m hotfix pop-in slot.
Nina Kramer: Quick timezone flag — 9:30 PT is rough for EMEA. Can we poll a couple options (Wed 9:30 PT vs Thu 16:00 CET every other week)?
Maya Patel: Good point. I'll run a poll. Doodle link I created: https://doodle.example/triage-times (will replace with calendar poll)
ops-bot: calendar-poll created by Maya Patel — https://doodle.example/triage-times
Ben Ortiz: Agenda checklist draft: ```- Quick lane (15m): owner ping, triage new bugs (P0/P1), hotfix pop-in <5m - Deep lane (25m): rotating topic (RFC/design) + one deep bug investigation - Action items: assign owners with due dates - 5m buffer for overrun```
Devon Li: Owner assignment idea: rotating roster + volunteers. Rule: owners pick up to 2 bugs; if none volunteer, oncall picks. Keep ownership list in the doc.
Nina Kramer: :thumbsup: Volunteer model works. Also propose adding 'rollback rehearsals' as a deep-lane item every 4 weeks.
Elliot Park: I'll timebox and take notes for the first 4 sessions. Can someone update the recurring invite once the poll finishes?
Maya Patel: I'll update. Poll runs till Thursday EOD — if >60% prefer alternate time we switch every-other-week cadence. Finalize by Friday EOD.
Ben Ortiz: Small wording tweak for the hotfix lane: "Hotfix pop-in" should be an explicit line: immediate triage <5m, escalate to incident channel if rollback needed.
Nina Kramer: Agreed. Also add a short pre-read tag so attendees can mark items they own.
Elliot Park: I'll create a pinned doc for agenda + minutes: https://docs.internal/triage-agenda (placeholder) and add a checklist template.
ops-bot: meeting created: "Weekly Engineering Triage — short/deep lanes" (recurring provisional)
Maya Patel: Thanks — tagging next week's owners for deep lane: @Ben Ortiz, @Devon Li. Let's test this format next Wed and iterate.
Ben Ortiz: :+1: I'll try to have a short RFC brief ready.
Devon Li: I'll prep the deep bug repro steps and a proposed mitigation plan.
Nina Kramer: I'll coordinate oncall overlap for the first two sessions and confirm timezone-friendly rotation if poll favors alternating weeks.
Elliot Park: Great. I'll capture the minute template and action owners during the meeting.
Maya Patel: Cool — action items: 1) finish poll (Maya) 2) update recurring invite (Maya) 3) create pinned agenda doc (Elliot) 4) owners prep pre-read (Ben/Devon). Back here after poll closes and we'll lock it in. Thanks all!
